newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hong Kong gold ends lower on Tokyo sales.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong gold ends lower on Tokyo sales.

text.p: Hong Kong gold ended slightly lower on Friday from New York's previous close on light selling from Japan that was barely countered by marginal buying from local and European concerns, bullion traders said.
"The Japanese were selling mainly on a higher dollar/yen," said a senior bullion dealer.
Thin activity during the day meant that even light selling pushed the price down, sources said.
Bullion ended at US$351.00/50 an ounce against New York's US$351.30/80 close on Thursday.
Small amounts of buying locally and from Europe failed to provide significant support, dealers said. The market saw physical demand just below $351 per ounce, they said.
Local gold ended HK$11 lower at HK$3,250 a tael.
The carry over charge at the Chinese Gold and Silver Exchange Society dropped to -4.00 from -3.90.
